description: Record where you have got to with one citation-source host: mark it planned, pitched, placed or declined as you pitch, get listed, or rule it out; none clears it. Statuses are stored per workspace per domain and come back on every list_citation_sources call, so the outreach list survives across sessions instead of living in someone's head. Use the exact `host` string from list_citation_sources. Needs Pro or higher: on Starter the MCP is read-only.

domain.description: Bare domain the target belongs to, e.g. 'acme.com'.

host.description: The target host exactly as list_citation_sources returned it, e.g. 'frase.io'.

status.description: Where this target stands: planned, pitched, placed or declined. none clears a status you set by mistake.

name: set_outreach_status
